headline: Inject disciplined engineering into your AI coding workflows
lede: Forget vibe coding. These modular skill sets force your AI agents to adhere to rigorous development methodologies like TDD and structured architectural refinement.

headline: Visualize your location history without cloud surveillance
lede: Reclaim your personal movement data using this local-only utility. It processes raw JSON exports into animated travel stories entirely on your own device.

headline: Automate your entire short-form video production pipeline
lede: Transform simple prompts into finished video content with this all-in-one suite. It integrates LLMs, voice synthesis, and sub-titling into a single, repeatable creative workflow.

headline: Manage your Logitech peripherals with this performance-first driver
lede: Ditch the bloated official drivers for this native Rust-based solution. It offers transparent hardware management and scriptable button mapping for Linux, Windows, and macOS.

headline: Consolidate your product telemetry into one unified warehouse
lede: PostHog eliminates tool sprawl by merging event capture, session recording, and feature flagging. It turns fragmented user behavior data into a single source of truth.

headline: Enforce type safety across expansive web application codebases
lede: TypeScript continues to define the standard for large-scale JavaScript development. Its static analysis ensures predictability and maintainability as your project grows in complexity.

headline: Standardize development cycles with autonomous agentic frameworks
lede: Superpowers forces AI models to adopt Socratic reasoning and mandatory testing before committing a single line of code. It effectively mitigates agent drift during complex multi-stage tasks.

headline: Automate your job search with AI-driven pipeline management
lede: Replace manual applications with a command-line tool that evaluates job listings against your profile. This system treats your career search like a structured software engineering pipeline.

headline: Build modular agentic workflows for the Cursor IDE
lede: Extend your development environment with a robust plugin marketplace. These integrations turn your editor into a central control plane for both code and enterprise operations.

headline: Optimize AI model execution with a high-performance modular stack
lede: Bridge the gap between Python flexibility and C-level execution speeds. The Modular platform provides the necessary compiler and kernel infrastructure to scale AI production workloads.
